verdict.rationale: AngelList Equity documents built-in vesting templates and the ability to build custom vesting templates, and employees can track their vesting schedules on a dashboard, so the core custom-schedule capability exists. The specific schedule types the story names are not documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of cliffs, milestone-based vesting, and acceleration on exit; explicit documentation of automatic vested-vs-unvested calculation for admins; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can define custom vesting schedules — cliffs, milestones, acceleration on exit — and the platform tracks vested vs unvested automatically

citations.quote: AngelList Equity comes ready with commonly used vesting templates. It is also easy to build your own vesting templates.
Employees can track vesting schedules, option values, and more on their dashboard.
